answer: Hey 👋 I'm Koushik. Ask me anything — try things like "what's your tech stack?", "are you available for work?", or "how do I reach you?".
I'm Koushik, an Full Stack Developer based in Kolkata, India. I build AI agents with full-stack capabilities that think, plan, and ship code autonomously.

Full-stack developer turned AI engineer. These days I focus on autonomous systems and agentic coding workflows — building AI agents that go beyond chat, then turning what I learn into tutorials for the channel.
Day-to-day: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Node.js. For AI:  n8n . For agentic coding: Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. Most projects glue some subset of those together.
I specialize in agentic coding with Claude Code / Codex / Cursor, plus full-stack web development with Node.js, React, JavaScript, and Python.
LangChain is one of my main tools for building agents — particularly the JS version. I've got a tutorial repo at github.com/leonvanzyl/langchain-js if you want to see how I use it.
n8n is my go-to for automation and no-code AI workflows. I keep a public template repo at github.com/leonvanzyl/n8n-workflows and run a full masterclass course on building AI agents with it.
Flowise is great for visual LLM flow building — drag-and-drop chains and agents. I cover it end-to-end in the flowise-masterclass-2025 repo.

Claude Code is where most of my agentic coding work happens now. Sub-agents, skills, hooks, custom commands — I've published tutorials on all of it. The agentic-coding-starter-kit repo is a good place to start.
Python and TypeScript are my daily drivers. Python for AI/automation work, JavaScript when I'm shipping web apps with Node.js. Plus the usual TypeScript wherever it's needed.

I take on selective consulting and collaboration work, mostly around Full Stack Developement , AI agents, agentic coding setups, and automation. Email me at careerkoushik2023@gmail.com with a quick brief and I'll let you know if it's a fit.
Rates depend entirely on scope. Send a quick description of what you're trying to build to careerkoushik2023@gmail.com and I'll come back with a number.
Mosselbay, South Africa (UTC+2). I work async most of the time and have collaborators across multiple time zones.
Best route is email: careerkoushik2023@gmail.com. I check it multiple times a day and do my best to respond to all reasonable inquiries within 24-48 hours.
YouTube channel is @leonvanzyl — step-by-step tutorials on building real-world AI: agents, automation workflows, vibe coding and agentic coding, with both code and no-code tools.

Most of my courses live on the channel and in companion GitHub repos — langchain-js, flowise-masterclass-2025, n8n-ai-agents-masterclass-2025, opencode-masterclass, plus a steady stream of shorter Claude Code tutorials.
Lately: deeper Claude Code workflows (sub-agents, plugins, skills), autonomous coding agents, and content on combining n8n with code-based agents. Most of it lands on YouTube within a week or two.
Everything's at github.com/leonvanzyl. Top repos: agentic-coding-starter-kit, autonomous-coding, langchain-js, flowise-masterclass-2025, n8n-workflows, localforge. ~88 public repos total.

Start by building something tiny end-to-end — a single agent that does one useful thing. Don't read frameworks cover to cover; pick a tool (n8n or LangChain or Claude Code), watch one full build-along tutorial, then immediately reskin it for your own problem.
Outside the laptop: family in India , and far too much time tinkering with whatever new AI tool dropped that week.
